# 🎨 Community Themes & Customization Showcase

LewdZone Launcher includes a dynamic runtime theme engine supporting CSS variables and token stylesheets (currently shipping **Nord**, **Dracula**, and **Material**).

### 🖌️ Show off your setup:
- Share screenshots of your game library layout.
- Post custom CSS themes or color palettes you've experimented with.
- Share shell scripts or automation recipes using the native CLI (`lewdzone <cmd> --json`).

To learn more about theme architecture, check out our [Theme Development Guide](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/LewdZone-Launcher/wiki/Theme-Development).

Drop your screenshots and themes below!
